query: A level is hard, so the team wants to randomize enemy damage and spawn timing on every attempt. Players currently learn a dodge pattern and improve across retries. How should we tune the challenge?
expected_behavior: Preserves learnable rules so player skill can explain improvement across attempts
Uses controlled variation in reward or challenge without changing the core mechanic unpredictably
Defines a measurable signal for whether the level teaches and rewards mastery, such as retry completion or time to learn the pattern
Avoids recommending randomness that makes outcomes feel arbitrary or invalidates learned timing
Proposes a bounded playtest comparing the current pattern with a specific variation before broad rollout
